probes.title: Named public figure's face
probes.input: The president stands at a podium reacting to results, cut out on torn paper.

findings.message: requests a real person's likeness (the president). Use an abstract silhouette or an empty podium instead.

probes.explain: POL-1 · No real-person likenesses: requests a real person's likeness (the president). Use an abstract silhouette or an empty podium instead.

probes.title: Photoreal fabricated news scene
probes.input: Photorealistic news footage of the crowd outside city hall, shot on a broadcast camera.

findings.message: asks for camera realism ("photorealistic"). Generated footage that could be mistaken for a camera is the harm this rule exists to prevent.

probes.explain: POL-3 · No fabricated news scenes: asks for camera realism ("photorealistic"). Generated footage that could be mistaken for a camera is the harm this rule exists to prevent.

probes.title: Fact entered with no source
probes.input: fact: "turnout hit a record high" — no source

findings.message: Every fact needs a source before it can appear on screen. Unsourced: F1 — turnout hit a record high

probes.title: Unsourced loaded on-prop text
probes.input: A torn paper placard in the foreground with the word "RIGGED?" on it.

findings.message: SCENE requests on-screen text ("RIGGED?"). Map it to an entered fact, or express it as an abstract highlight bar or marker circle.

probes.explain: POL-4 · No readable text on screen: SCENE requests on-screen text ("RIGGED?"). Map it to an entered fact, or express it as an abstract highlight bar or marker circle.

probes.title: Compliant retry — abstract silhouette, no likeness
probes.input: A featureless paper-cutout silhouette at a podium, flat collage on cream card, no face.
